pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Gratitude? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Gratitude has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Gratitude.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Gratitude with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith on Gratitude to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Greetings? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Greetings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hadith on Greetings has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Greetings.
   D. Use Hadith on Greetings to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surah: has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Selected Surah: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah:.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah.
   C. Use Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets.
   B. Use Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Say Miracles of Prophets has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Miracles of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracles of Prophets.
   D. Apply the teaching of Miracles of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on good Behaviour? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on good Behaviour has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on good Behaviour to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on good Behaviour with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on good Behaviour.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

11. Which response best shows understanding of Nullifiers of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Nullifiers of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nullifiers of Swalah.
   C. Use Nullifiers of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Nullifiers of Swalah has no place in daily life.

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Constitution of Madina and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Surah: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on good Behaviour and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Greetings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
